c74object.name: tap.noise~
c74object.description: The tap.noise~ object generates various types of noise in the signal domain: white, pink, brown, blue, or gaussian. The white/pink/brown/blue generators are faithful ports of the original TapTools noise object (an LCG white source plus the same coloring filters); gaussian draws from a normal distribution with adjustable mean and deviation. All generators are deterministic per seed — the same seed reproduces the identical sample sequence on every render, and different seeds decorrelate multiple instances (e.g. under mc.). Mono: wrap in an mc. operator for multichannel.

method.name: clear
method.description: Reset the coloring-filter memory (the pink/brown/blue filter states).

attribute.name: mode
attribute.description: The color of the noise to generate: white, pink, brown, blue, or gauss.

attribute.name: seed
attribute.description: Seed for the noise generators (1 or higher; default 1). The output is deterministic per seed, so renders reproduce exactly; give mc. instances different seeds to decorrelate them. Setting the seed restarts the sequence. The default seed reproduces the legacy object's sequence.

attribute.name: gain
attribute.description: Output gain in decibels (default 0). Does not apply to gaussian noise, whose level is defined by mean and deviation.

attribute.name: mean
attribute.description: Mean of the gaussian distribution (default 0). Used only when mode is gauss.

attribute.name: deviation
attribute.description: Standard deviation of the gaussian distribution (0-1, default 1). Used only when mode is gauss.
